With reference to the drawings, a bar machining system and a bar feeder according to a first embodiment of the present invention will now be described. FIG. 1 is a front view schematically showing a bar machining system comprising a bar machining apparatus and a bar feeder disposed adjacent thereto according to the first embodiment of the present invention. FIG. 2 is a cross-sectional view taken along the line 2-2 in FIG. 1.
